name: Alice Flights
description:
Alice is Israel's top travel and flights provider, now right inside your chat. Use the Search Flights tool to find flights between any two cities — one-way or round-trip, for any mix of adults, children, infants, and seniors, from economy through first class — for travel to, from, and within Israel and worldwide.

Alice returns a curated set of options, each tagged best, cheapest, or fastest, so you can see at a glance why an option stands out: the best balance of price and time, the lowest fare, or the shortest trip. Every result includes prices, total durations, layovers, remaining seats, flight numbers, and a direct booking link so you can complete your booking on the Alice website.

Alice speaks Hebrew: when the conversation is in Hebrew, results are shown in Hebrew with full right-to-left layout — so Israeli travelers can search and compare flights in their own language.

Alice is read-only. It searches and presents travel options, but never books, pays, or changes anything on your behalf. The details you provide — origin, destination, dates, passenger counts, and cabin class — are forwarded once to Alice's flight search engine to fulfil your request and are not retained. No account or sign-in is required to use the connector.

Whether you're planning a quick weekend getaway or comparing fares for a family trip, Alice makes flight search a natural part of the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Alice Flights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Alice Flights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.alice.co.il/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Alice Flights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alice Flights provides these MCP tools: search_flights.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Alice Flights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Alice Flights in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.

_published_faq.name: Does Alice Flights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Alice Flights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Alice Flights is developed by Alice. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
